description: Address review issues: pagination fix, slug validation, error handling, useEffect split, hot topics comment
steps: Step 1: Fix hot topics endpoint to cap at 50 results with no pagination. Fix sorted topics to use offset-based pagination with page param. Keep latest sort using cursor-based pagination.
Step 2: Add slug format validation regex and reserved words blocklist in GroupCreate handler.
Step 3: Check error from GroupMemberRepository.Create in CreateGroup service, delete group on failure.
Step 4: Split useEffect in groups.$slug.tsx into two: one for members/sticky (depends on group), one for topics (depends on group, sort).
Step 5: Add comment explaining hotLoaded design choice.
acceptance_criteria: Hot topics endpoint returns capped list without pagination
Slug validation rejects invalid formats and reserved words
Member insert error is checked and group is deleted on failure
Sticky topics useEffect does not depend on sort
findings: All 5 review issues addressed. go build, pnpm typecheck, and pnpm lint all pass. Hot topics uses simple capped list (no pagination). Sorted topics use offset/page-based approach with page number encoded in cursor string for LoadMore compatibility.
